shortBio.en: Homme / Grohl / Jones supergroup; one-album hard-rock summit.
shortBio.zh: Homme / Grohl / Jones 超级组合；一张专辑的 hard-rock 峰会。

body.en:
Active mainly 2009–2010. Debut album stacks Homme’s desert riffs, Grohl’s drums (and some vocal), Jones’s bass/keys—Zeppelin lineage meeting QOTSA/Foo methods.

Bridge exhibit for the chronicle: proof mid/late-career players still form short-run hard-rock units. Not a long catalog; the lineup itself is the object.
body.zh:
主要活动于 2009–2010。首专堆叠 Homme 沙漠 riff、Grohl 鼓（及部分人声）、Jones 贝斯/键盘——Zeppelin 谱系遇见 QOTSA/Foo 方法。

编年桥接展品：证明中后期职业乐手仍可组成短周期 hard-rock 单位。目录不长；阵容本身即对象。

whyMatters.en: 2009–10 hard-rock trio: Josh Homme, Dave Grohl, John Paul Jones—cross-decade personnel experiment with one self-titled album.
whyMatters.zh: 2009–10 hard-rock 三人组：Josh Homme、Dave Grohl、John Paul Jones——跨年代人事实验，一张同名专辑。
